new_hypothesis.name: gecko_breadth_burst
new_hypothesis.mechanism: Unique-buyer COUNT growth (breadth_acceleration = m5 unique buyers vs prior windows) is structurally distinct from price/volume momentum signals the bot already uses. A token going from 2 to 50 unique buyers in 5 minutes reflects ORGANIC crowd attention forming, not single-whale pump-and-dump pressure. Buyer breadth at age <15min historically precedes the first 2-5x leg because the crowd is the demand that drives the move; if the crowd is already in (>15min, breadth flattening), entry is late. The signal is multi-dimensional (breadth × reserve × age) which is why it's not captured by single-axis scanners.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Three reasons it doesn't get arbed: (a) GeckoTerminal lags chain by ~60s but copy_trade lags by 45s+RPC anyway, so we are NOT at a structural disadvantage vs sniper bots; (b) the m5 buyer-COUNT signal is noisier than price-action so pure snipers ignore it (they want block-0 entry, not crowd-formation entry); (c) requires combining 4 features that no public retail dashboard surfaces together. Source feed is multi-DEX (Raydium, Meteora, Orca, Pump.fun all mixed) so it catches direct-launch teams that DexScreener trending misses entirely until they pump.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Read sol_gecko_breadth_log.json on each cycle (already populated by existing poller). Trigger: breadth_acceleration >= 20 AND reserve_usd in [$5k, $250k] AND age_min <= 15 AND vol_m5_usd >= $2k AND mint not already held AND mint not in cooldown AND security gate passes. Size: 2.5% of bankroll. Exit: existing position-mgmt (8% stop, 10% trailing arm at +10%, 60-min time limit). Fits cleanly into _process_signal as a new strategy entry path; the candidate construction is just reading an existing JSON file, not adding any new poller or HTTP call.
new_hypothesis.data_required: ZERO new infrastructure. sol_gecko_breadth_log.json is already populated by the existing gecko_breadth poller. Schema confirmed (subagent 4): 500-row ring buffer with mint, pool_address, name, age_min, reserve_usd, fdv_usd, vol_m5_usd, vol_h1_usd, m5/m15/m30/h1 buyer/seller/buy/sell counts, breadth_acceleration, breadth_ratio_h1. Sources: 498 from new_pools, 2 from trending_pools. Just needs a consumer in degen_bot.py — estimated ~40-60 LOC for a new strategy entry path.
new_hypothesis.evidence: Subagent-4 sampled current sol_gecko_breadth_log.json (50-min window): 19 candidates met breadth_acceleration>=20 AND reserve>=$5k AND age<=15min, deduplicated mint-wise. Extrapolation: ~22 raw/hour, ~5-8 dedup/hour, ~120-200/day raw funnel into security gate. After gate passes (rugcheck/goplus typical 30-50% pass rate) and confidence threshold, expected 8 actual fires/day. Mechanism evidence: three live mints showing the pattern right now — UAP (breadth_accel 30, reserve $131k, vol_m5 $44k at age 1min); Tesla Semi (breadth_accel 43, reserve $118k, vol_m5 $42k at age 0.84min); HANTA spinoff cohort. This is BRAND NEW DATA for the bot — the poller has been writing it, no strategy has ever read it.

proposals_for_survival_brain.target: INFRASTRUCTURE — fix run-274 boosts enrichment regression (0/61 enriched)
proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: Live audit of sol_dex_boosts_log.json (subagent 1): every single entry post-restart has enriched=False. _persist_dex_boost_event calls _get_token_info(mint) and only sets enriched=True when result is non-None — that branch has NEVER fired since the code shipped at 12:05 EDT. 61 entries observed, 0 successful. Same DexScreener endpoint returns valid 200s when invoked outside the bot, so the failure is in the bot's runtime path (likely an exception swallowed in _get_token_info, or token not yet on DexScreener at boost-discovery moment with no retry). Until this is fixed, boosts_top_feed_breakout strategy CANNOT EVALUATE — the liq>$50k filter rejects every candidate because liq_usd is never present.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: Run-274 shipped boosts liq enrichment ~35 min before this run. Expected: enriched=True populated within first hour. Observed: 0/61 entries enriched (0%). Run-274 priority_reasoning explicitly stated 'at least 1-2 boost entries should accumulate enriched data within the first hour after restart' as the verification criterion — the criterion has FAILED.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: After fix: ~50-80% of boost entries should populate enriched=True (some young mints will legitimately have no DexScreener data yet — that's OK, that's enriched=False). Once N>=20 enriched entries exist, boosts_top_feed_breakout becomes ship-ready with the 65% h6-win cohort observed in this audit.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: If post-fix enrichment rate stays <40% (i.e. fix didn't address root cause), revert and investigate _get_token_info call path more deeply. If retry causes DexScreener 429s (>10% rate), back off the call frequency.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: N=20 boost entries observed within 60 min of fix to confirm enrichment is firing.
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Revert the enrichment branch to the pre-run-274 state (drop the _get_token_info call, drop the enriched field). Boosts log goes back to schema-incomplete; boosts_top_feed_breakout stays blocked.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Minimal — pure infrastructure debugging. Worst case: a few extra DexScreener calls get retried and 429-throttled (still well under DS limits). The ALTERNATIVE risk (do nothing) is worse — boosts_top_feed_breakout stays blocked indefinitely while a 65% h6-win cohort sits invisible.
proposals_for_survival_brain.implementation_hint: Most likely fix: wrap _get_token_info call with explicit try/except that LOGS the exception (today it appears to silently catch and return None). OR: add a 60-second deferred retry — many boost-discoveries are <1 min old mints that DexScreener hasn't indexed yet, so the first call fails but a retry 60s later succeeds. OR: use the 'tokens/v1/solana/{mint}' DexScreener endpoint which the audit confirmed returns valid data.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: The existing gecko_breadth poller writes ~500 entries to sol_gecko_breadth_log.json per ~50-min ring buffer cycle, including pre-computed breadth_acceleration field. Subagent 4 confirms 19 actionable candidates per 50-minute window meet (breadth_accel>=20 AND reserve>=$5k AND age<=15min). NO STRATEGY READS THIS FILE. The bot is dormant 33h+ on the existing channels (copy_trade lag-limited, fresh_profile rarely fires in CHOP) — gecko_breadth_burst gives a NEW lead-pool that bypasses copy_trade lag entirely AND covers multi-DEX launches (Raydium direct, Meteora, Orca) that DexScreener trending misses. Mechanism is structurally distinct from price-momentum (it measures buyer COUNT, not price velocity) so it stacks orthogonally with existing filters. Best ROI per LOC of any current research finding: ~40-60 LOC for a new strategy entry path that consumes already-existing local data.

Far less than the opportunity cost of leaving a 22-cand/hour funnel completely unused.

proposals_for_survival_brain.target: GLOBAL — exclude vol_h24/liq > 20x at entry (V/L churn-tail kill)
proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: Subagent 3's full-log mining (N=997) found a clean monotonic stop-rate climb: V/L<0.5x stop_rate 18.2%, 0.5-2x 27.6%, 2-5x 36.8%, 5-20x 45.8%, **>20x 50.3%**. The >20x cell is N=298 (30% of all trades) with WR 35.2%, mean -4.53%, stop_rate 50.3%. Mechanism: V/L>20x means 24h volume is more than 20x the current liquidity pool — this is a classic 'late churn / exit liquidity' environment where retail is recycling positions on a thin book, and any new entry is buying late-stage distribution. The existing chop_animal_token_gate, chop_dead_zone_kill_gate, and m5_pump_skip catch SOME of these but not via this mechanic. Excluding V/L>20x removes 30% of historical entries from the WORST stop-rate bucket. Combined with the V/L<0.5x dead-pair tail (N=33, WR 24.2%) the cleanest band is V/L in [0.5x, 5x] (combined N=330, stop_rate ~30%).
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: All_time global: N=997, WR 35.5%, stop_loss_rate 50.6% (per sol_strategy_stats.json). V/L>20x cohort: N=298 (30% of trades), stop_rate 50.3%, mean pnl -4.53%, WR 35.2%. V/L>10x cohort: ~53% of all trades, stop-rate climbing to >50% per the monotonic pattern.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Block ~30% of historical entries (V/L>20x). Predicted global stop-rate: 50.6% -> ~46% (the worst cohort's stops removed). Predicted global WR: 35.5% -> ~36% (small WR change since the cell's WR was near average). Predicted cumulative pnl: avoid the -4.5% mean × 298 trades = ~+13.4% pnl avoided historically. Net SOL impact: ~+0.013 SOL/year at current volume, more in normal trade-flow regime.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: Rolling 50-trade post-implementation: if shadow-tracked V/L>20x candidates (log what would have been bought, do NOT buy) show WR > 40% AND mean pnl > 0% -> drop the filter (was a false positive). If filter starves the funnel below 1 trade/day for 5+ consecutive days, consider relaxing to V/L>50x.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: N=30 newly-excluded shadow records, plus N=30 still-firing in-band cohort to confirm differential persists out-of-sample.
proposals_for_survival_brain.regime_scope: ANY (V/L churn-tail mechanic is regime-independent; the monotonic stop-rate climb held across the full 997-trade log spanning multiple regimes).
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Single-line revert in _process_signal — remove the (volume_h24 / liquidity > 20.0) skip condition. Restore original behavior.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Excludes ~30% of entries; if those were wins, opportunity cost ~ -0.005 SOL/week. Far smaller than the +0.013 SOL/year edge the historical sample suggests.

proposals_for_survival_brain.target: NEW STRATEGY — pump_fun_graduation_snipe with strict filter (paper-trade phase first)

proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Minimal — additive infrastructure. Worst case: WebSocket flakes and we waste a small amount of CPU on reconnect attempts.
proposals_for_survival_brain.implementation_hint: DEFER until pump_fun_graduation_snipe shadow-validates (proposal above).
